description: Read conversation messages and tool calls from AI coding agent sessions
comment: Supports Claude, Claude Desktop, Copilot, Cursor, Codex, Gemini, and Grok (auto-detect by path, or force with `source`)
example: SELECT * FROM read_conversations(path='~/.claude') LIMIT 10; SELECT * FROM read_conversations(source='grok', path='~/.grok') LIMIT 10;

description: Read current plans from agent sessions
comment: Claude: plans/*.md; Copilot/Grok plan files; Codex CLI and Work latest plan snapshot

description: Read todo and checklist items with status tracking
comment: Claude: todos/*.json; Copilot checkpoint checklists; Codex CLI and Work plan checkboxes
example: SELECT content, status FROM read_todos() WHERE status != 'completed';

comment: Claude: history.jsonl; Copilot command history; Codex CLI and Work user prompts
example: SELECT display FROM read_history() ORDER BY line_number DESC LIMIT 10;

description: Read daily activity statistics (message, session, and tool call counts)
comment: Claude cache, Grok session signals, and Codex CLI and Work local records
example: SELECT date, message_count FROM read_stats() ORDER BY date DESC;
